'''André Fortin''' (born 1956) is a French Canadian mathematician, known for his research in applied and industrial mathematics. He holds a [[NSERC]] Research Chair in High Performance Scientific Computing at [[Université Laval]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nserc-crsng.gc.ca/Chairholders-TitulairesDeChaire/Chairholder-Titulaire_eng.asp?pid=557 |title=NSERC – Chairholder Profile |website=Nserc-crsng.gc.ca |date=2014-05-20 |accessdate=2017-01-22}}</ref>

Fortin earned his Ph.D. from the Université Laval in 1984.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=29740 |title=André Fortin – The Mathematics Genealogy Project |website=Genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu |date= |accessdate=2017-01-22}}</ref>
His thesis advisor was Michel Fortin, a now emeritus professor of the Université Laval, recipient of Prix Summa in 1987 and prize CAIMS-SCMAI in 2005 and a member of the [[Royal Society of Canada]] in 1999.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fsg.ulaval.ca/faculte/la-fsg/les-prix-summa/recipiendaires/ |title=FacultĂŠ des sciences et de gĂŠnie: RĂŠcipiendaires |website=Fsg.ulaval.ca |date= |accessdate=2017-01-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.math.uwaterloo.ca/~caims/Awards/fortincit_eng.html |title=CAIMS*SCMAI 2005 Research Prize Winner Citation |website=Math.uwaterloo.ca |date= |accessdate=2017-01-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rec.ulaval.ca/rectorat/Honneuretdistinctions/Professeursemerites/notesbio2002/notesbiomfortin2002.htm |title=Vice-rectorat exécutif |website=Rec.ulaval.ca |date= |accessdate=2017-01-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Michel_Fortin |title=Michel Fortin (Laval University, Québec) on ResearchGate – Expertise: Applied Mathematics |website=Researchgate.net |date= |accessdate=2017-01-22}}</ref>

==Career==
He is the director of the Groupe Interdisciplinaire de Recherche en Éléments Finis ([http://www.giref.ulaval.ca GIREF]).<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.giref.ulaval.ca/chercheurs.html |title=Chercheurs – GIREF |website=Giref.ulaval.ca |date=2016-12-22 |accessdate=2017-01-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202031449/http://www.giref.ulaval.ca/chercheurs.html |archive-date=2017-02-02 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In addition to over 150 research papers on mathematics, he has written a student textbook on numerical analysis for engineers "Analyse numérique pour ingénieurs" in 1994.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://giref.ulaval.ca/liste-publications.html |title=Liste des publications – GIREF |website=Giref.ulaval.ca |date= |accessdate=2017-01-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170116181717/http://giref.ulaval.ca/liste-publications.html |archive-date=2017-01-16 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="ulaval1">{{cite web |url=http://giref.ulaval.ca/afortin/livre-ananum.html |title=Analyse numérique pour ingénieurs – GIREF |website=Giref.ulaval.ca |date=2016-12-22 |accessdate=2017-01-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170116181642/http://giref.ulaval.ca/afortin/livre-ananum.html |archive-date=2017-01-16 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.presses-polytechnique.ca/fr/analyse-numerique-pour-ingenieurs-5e-edition |title=Analyse numérique pour ingénieurs, 5e édition &#124; Presses internationales Polytechnique |website=Presses-polytechnique.ca |date=2016-08-08 |accessdate=2017-01-22}}</ref>  The textbook has been awarded the Prix Roberval in 1996.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://prixroberval.utc.fr/iso_album/laureats_prix_roberval_depuis_1.pdf|title=PRIX ROBERVAL GRAND PUBLIC |website=Prixroberval.utc.fr |accessdate=2017-01-22}}</ref>

Moreover, Fortin has received the CAIMS-Fields Industrial Mathematics Prize in 2012 in recognition of his exceptional contribution throughout his career to research in industrial mathematics.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.caims.ca/people/andr%C3%A9-fortin |title=André Fortin |website=Caims.ca |date= |accessdate=2017-01-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202004617/https://www.caims.ca/people/andr%C3%A9-fortin |archive-date=2017-02-02 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
